However, many SGHs are needed in order to cover multiple frequency bands. Such is the case for the widely used frequency range of 1-18 GHz where the three-antenna gain extrapolation method requires a set of 20 reference antennas to conduct the calibration. A single dual-ridge horn antenna (DRHA) however, can cover the entire 1-18 GHz, but exhibits significant amounts of multipath reflections from the measurement chamber, raising the gain uncertainty to as much as 1-2 dB, many orders of magnitude worse than the ±0.07 dB uncertainty for NIST-calibrated SGH antennas. That uncertainty makes it harder for industry to determine antenna gain accurately, reducing the effectiveness of an otherwise highly efficient DRHA. What is NIST on a Chip? NIST has embarked on a revolutionary program that will bring cutting-edge measurement-science technology and expertise from our labs directly to users in commerce, medicine, defense and academia. We are developing a suite of inherently accurate measurement technologies that operate according to the precise, time-tested principles of quantum physics. The ultimate goal of NIST on a Chip technology is for it to be deployed nearly anywhere and anytime, without the need for NIST’s traditional measurement services. We are seeking partnerships with the U.S. private sector and other government agencies to bring these technologies to commercial reality and unleash new capabilities for American innovation. The No FEAR Act requires each Federal agency to publicly post summary statistical data relating to equal employment opportunity complaints filed against the agency on a quarterly basis during each fiscal year, and cumulative fiscal year end data for the five preceding years. pages.text: Nobel Peace Prize AR | الأمم المتحدة Skip to main content الأمم المتحدة وجائزة نوبل للسلام الأمم المتحدة وجائزة نوبل للسلام استلهم ألفريد نوبل وصيته التي حررها عام 1895 من إيمانه بوحدة الأسرة الإنسانية. ونصّت الوصية على أن تُمنح جائزة نوبل للسلام للشخص الذي يبذل أكبر جهد في سبيل «تعزيز الأخوّة بين الأمم، وإلغاء الجيوش الدائمة أو تقليصها، وعقد مؤتمرات السلام وتشجيعها». مُنحت جائزة نوبل للسلام المرموقة 13 مرة للأمم المتحدة و وكالاتها المتخصصة وصناديقها وبرامجها ، والمنظمات المرتبطة بها، ولمسؤولين حاليين وسابقين في المنظمة. وقد نالت المفوضية السامية للأمم المتحدة لشؤون اللاجئين هذه الجائزة مرتين، في عامي 1954 و 1981 . وكرّمت لجنة نوبل النرويجية أيضًا أمينين عامين للأمم المتحدة، هما كوفي عنان و داغ همرشولد ، تقديرًا لجهودهما. وعقب فوزه بالجائزة مناصفة مع الأمم المتحدة عام 2001، أعرب الأمين العام كوفي عنان، في كلمة وجهها إلى موظفي المنظمة، عن أمله في أن «تدفعنا هذه الجائزة إلى المضي قدمًا، وتشجعنا جميعًا على النهوض بمهامنا بعزيمة أشد». «على مدى مئة عام، سعت لجنة نوبل النرويجية إلى توطيد التعاون المنظّم بين الدول. وقد أتاحت نهاية الحرب الباردة للأمم المتحدة أخيرًا أن تنهض على نحو أكمل بالدور الذي أُنشئت من أجله. وتقف المنظمة اليوم في طليعة الجهود الرامية إلى تحقيق السلام والأمن في العالم، وفي صدارة التعبئة الدولية لمواجهة التحديات الاقتصادية والاجتماعية والبيئية التي تواجه العالم... وتود لجنة نوبل النرويجية، في عامها المئوي، أن تعلن أن الطريق الوحيد القائم على التفاوض لتحقيق السلام والتعاون على الصعيد العالمي يمر عبر الأمم المتحدة». معهد نوبل النرويجي أوسلو، 12 تشرين الأول/أكتوبر 2001 الحائزون على جائزة نوبل من الأمم المتحدة 2026 - نافانيثيم بيلاي مُنحت جائزة نوبل للسلام لعام 202

pages.text: Norfolk holidaymaker says visa error blocked entry to Italy Skip to content Site search Home News Sport Business Technology Health Culture Arts Travel Earth Audio Video Live Documentaries Weather Newsletters Watch Live Holidaymaker says visa error blocked entry to Italy 1 hour ago Share Save Add as preferred on Google Owen Sennitt Norfolk Paula Pugh Paula Pugh, pictured with her husband Andy, was refused entry into Italy A holidaymaker said she believed she was refused entry at the Italian border due to a computer error that recorded her as having overstayed a visa. Paula Pugh, 61, from Swaffham, Norfolk, travelled from Stansted Airport to Calabria in southern Italy for a five-day holiday to celebrate her husband's birthday in September. After arriving she was told she had exceeded her 90-day visa-free allowance to the Schengen area and was put on a return flight, but Pugh said this was a database error and that she had only spent 22 days in the area. The European Commission said it is the responsibility of individual countries to correct any errors. The 61-year-old said the experience made her feel "like a criminal", but so far she has been unable to identify the source of the error. Her experience also cost her hundreds of pounds after she had to pay for her return flight back to the UK and she lost money she had already spent on the holiday. Pugh and her husband arrived at Reggio Calabria Airport at 12:40 BST but was denied entry. pages.text: North Dakota Badlands 2026: When to visit, where to stay, and what to do | National Geographic TRAVEL BEST OF THE WORLD Why you should visit the rugged North Dakota Badlands in 2026 Discover the best seasons to visit, where to stay near Theodore Roosevelt National Park, and how to explore this otherworldly landscape. The Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library is set to open in July 2026 outside Medora, North Dakota. Photograph by Image Professionals GmbH, Alamy Stock Photo By Stephanie Pearson Published October 21, 2025 Theodore Roosevelt first traveled to the Badlands on a hunting trip in 1883. He was so taken by the otherworldly landscape of pastel buttes, trilling meadowlarks, and disappearing bison, that he returned in 1884 to grieve the simultaneous deaths of his wife and mother, raising cattle and working on the wild frontier for almost three years. Its “desolate, grim beauty” so changed Roosevelt that he famously wrote, “I would not have been president had it not been for my experience in North Dakota .” Opening on July 4, 2026, the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library celebrates the Badlands as much as it does the 26th president. Designed by Norwegian architectural firm Snøhetta, the state-of-the-art, sustainable library sits high on a lonely butte outside of Medora, a military camp turned frontier town named after a French nobleman’s wife. The 93,000-square-foot library disappears into its surroundings, camouflaged by a living roof sprouting native plants, part of a 1.3-mile walking trail that provides sweeping views toward the national park. Sir Mark Rowley, Britain's most senior police officer, recently said policing was "heading for failure" without change and has proposed between eight and 10 regional forces should be established. But Jo Coles, York and North Yorkshire's Labour deputy mayor, warned bigger forces would jeopardise links between officers and their communities, adding that merging forces would prove a "distraction" and would "take resources from the front line". A Home Office spokesperson said the current model of policing "has not changed since the 1960s and is no longer fit for purpose". The Redding-based district office oversees field offices in Alturas, Arcata, Redding and Susanville and a field station in Cedarville. The district contains two distinct regions. On the east, the Applegate and Eagle Lake field offices oversee vast expanses of public lands in a high desert landscape, including about a million and a half acres in far western Nevada. Small communities depend on public lands for economic benefits, primarily through livestock grazing, and tourism uses ranging from hunting to mountain biking. These lands provide habitat for 14 wild horse herds and special status species, such as greater sage grouse. On the west, the Arcata and Redding field offices manage smaller, scattered blocks of public land with more emphasis on recreation demands from urban areas. The district includes the upper Colorado River corridor along with the White and Yampa rivers. It is home to some of the largest deer and elk herds in the area, along with pronghorn, bighorn sheep and a wide variety of other wildlife. The Northwest District contains the majority of the Colorado range of the Greater Sage Grouse. On Thursday, Huang stepped down from the US chip giant after admitting he had an affair. He was reportedly involved with a woman named Alice Huang, who ran Singaporean data centre company Megaspeed, a major buyer of Nvidia's chips. For decades, Singapore has painstakingly cultivated a reputation as an open, business-friendly economy offering easy access to both the US and Chinese markets. With the AI boom, it has become a major hub for the trade of high-end semiconductor chips in recent years. Singapore was the second-largest billing centre globally last year for Nvidia, accounting for nearly a fifth of what the US chip giant earns. But notably, less than 1% of its earnings were for chips that actually entered Singapore, as the island acts as a hub for many Asian companies to place orders and send them elsewhere. It describes occupations in terms of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required as well as how the work is performed in terms of tasks, work activities, and other descriptors. O*NET database Content Model Every occupation requires a different mix of knowledge, skills, and abilities, and is performed using a variety of activities and tasks. These distinguishing characteristics, or "descriptors", of an occupation are collected, codified, and described by the O*NET Content Model . This hierarchical model starts with six domains (or categories), describing the day-to-day aspects of the job and the qualifications and interests of the typical worker. The model includes nearly 277 descriptors collected by the O*NET program, along with other occupational data collected by other federal agencies such as the Bureau of Labor Statistics . Data Collection Real-world information The Data Collection program brings the Content Model frameworks to life with results from the working public. Oakland, the president argued , was beyond saving. “And then you have, of course, Baltimore and Oakland. They’re so far gone. We don’t even talk about that any more,” Trump said. But as Trump was making these comments, Oakland was in the midst of a historic drop in homicides. The Bay Area city ended 2025 with 67 people killed, according to data from the Oakland police department, half of its 2021 high of 134. It’s the lowest number of violent deaths recorded in 25 years. October 25-31 is National Lead Poisoning Prevention Week Released October 22, 2026 Next week is National Lead Poisoning Prevention Week (NLPPW). pages.text: Oficina de Normas de Gestión Laboral | U.S. Department of Labor Skip to main content Oficina de Normas de Gestión Laboral La Oficina de Normas de Gestión Laboral (Office of Labor-Management Standards, u OLMS, por sus siglas en inglés) pertenece al Departamento de Trabajo de los Estados Unidos y es responsable de administrar y aplicar la mayoría de las disposiciones de la Ley de Notificación y Divulgación Gestión Laboral (Labor-Management Reporting and Disclosure Act, o LMRDA, por sus siglas en inglés). Dicha ley fue adoptada con el fin de garantizar normas básicas de democracia y responsabilidad fiscal en las organizaciones laborales del sector privado. Los sindicatos que representan a los empleados del Correo Postal de los Estados Unidos también se hallan sujetos a la LMRDA. Los sindicatos de empleados federales se hallan sujetos a normas similares conforme a la Ley de Reforma del Servicio Civil de 1978 (Civil Service Reform Act, o CSRA, por sus siglas in inglés) y a la Ley del Servicio Exterior de 1980. La OLMS anima a que los oficiales y los miembros del sindicato, así como otros individuos afectados por la LMRDA, se pongan en contacto con la agencia para discutir de problemas, presenten quejas u obtengan información sobre la LMRDA. Además, la OLMS fomenta la conformidad voluntaria con la LMRDA al informar a oficiales del sindicato y a otros individuos de sus responsabilidades y al animar a los miembros del sindicato a que ejerzan sus derechos. The Electronic Forms System (EFS) is the Office of Labor-Management Standards’ (OLMS) web-based system that enables labor organizations, their officials, employers, labor relations consultants, and surety companies to complete and submit LM reports to OLMS. Currently, EFS is available for use by all LM filers: Forms LM-1, LM-2, LM-3, LM-4, LM-10, LM-15, LM-15A, LM-16, LM-20, LM-21, LM-30, and S-1, as well as simplified annual reports, filers. Access the OLMS EFS to register for an EFS User ID and password, obtain a union PIN, as well as edit your account information or retrieve your existing password or User ID. By accessing the OLMS EFS, you can also obtain, work on, or sign and submit an LM form. For more information on registering with EFS, see the Registration Help page . EFS allows anyone with a web-enabled computer to complete, sign, and electronically file a Form LM-1, LM-2, LM-3, LM-4, LM-10, LM-15, LM-15A, LM-16, LM-20, LM-21, LM-30, and S-1, as well as a simplified annual report, without purchasing a digital signature or downloading special software. EFS performs all calculations for the LM report and completes a form error check prior to submission to OLMS. pages.text: One thing Hollywood gets right about Ancient Rome | National Geographic Premium HISTORY & CULTURE One thing Hollywood gets right about Ancient Rome Gladiators really were sex symbols—just not in the way one might expect. Gladiators were ancient Roman sex symbols Rebecca Hale, National Geographic By Harry Sidebottom Published July 24, 2026 Hollywood is often criticized for getting history wrong, rarely more so than in films about Rome . One could take issue with the lack of color, whether in the robes that clothe posh-sounding British actors or the statues and other works in marble stripped of their polychromy. In arguably the most famous movie about Rome, Gladiator , inaccuracies abound, from puzzling choices in how the gladiators are armed to the tigers released to endanger the combatants. Credulity is strained even further in the sequel when a naval fight is recreated in the Colosseum (which could not be flooded by the period in which the film is set) and great white sharks devour those who fall into the water. The heights of physical impossibility are reached when a gladiator rides a rhinoceros, complete with saddle and stirrups, into the arena. But there is one thing Hollywood gets right. Gladiators were ancient Roman sex symbols, although not in the way one might expect, or that Hollywood portrays. (Who really built Rome?) As the graffiti etched into barracks in Pompeii capture, gladiators saw themselves as sex symbols. The most well-known opinions are those released or announced in cases in which the Court has heard oral argument. Each opinion sets out the Court’s judgment and its reasoning and may include the majority or principal opinion as well as any concurring or dissenting opinions. All opinions in a single case are published together and are prefaced by a syllabus prepared by the Reporter of Decisions that summarizes the Court’s decision. The Justice who authors the majority or principal opinion often will summarize the opinion from the bench during a Court session. The Court may also dispose of cases in per curiam opinions, which do not identify the author. These cases frequently resolve cases summarily, often without oral argument. But per curiam opinions have sometimes been issued in argued cases. Try again ADVANCED SEARCH DOCKET SEARCH Search Home > Oral Arguments Argument Transcripts Argument Audio Calendars and Lists Courtroom Seating Oral Arguments The Court holds oral argument in about 70-80 cases each year. The arguments are an opportunity for the Justices to ask questions directly of the attorneys representing the parties to the case, and for the attorneys to highlight arguments that they view as particularly important. Arguments are generally scheduled on specified Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday mornings beginning on the first Monday in October, and continuing through the end of April. Typically, the Court holds two arguments each day beginning at 10:00 a.m. The days on which arguments are held are identified on the Court’s yearly calendar . The specific cases to be argued each day, and the attorneys scheduled to argue them, are identified on hearing lists for each session and on the day call for each argument session. The Court is currently conducting a pilot program in which members of the public may apply for Courtroom seating through an online lottery .
